name: Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna Kit - Graphite Grey | 2, 3 or 5 Person
description: Description Imagine stepping into a warm, quiet space where the rest of the day finally releases its grip—where the soft glow behind the backrest, the scent of natural spruce, and the deep, enveloping heat give you a moment that is entirely yours. The KOHLER® C1™ Indoor Sauna transforms an ordinary corner of your home into a daily sanctuary—one that feels handcrafted, intentional, and profoundly restorative. This isn’t just a sauna; it’s the identity of someone who values deliberate living. Someone who understands that wellness isn’t an escape you schedule—it’s a ritual you build into the walls of your home. The C1 is crafted for exactly that level of ownership: a space designed not only to support your body, but to elevate the way you live inside your home. Why do you think so many high-performers, wellness experts, and long-term health–focused homeowners call heat therapy a non-negotiable part of their routine? It’s because the gains compound. Stress levels decrease. Sleep deepens. Muscles recover faster. And with a true Finnish-style heater at the core, the C1 provides the purity and consistency that makes daily use not just possible, but deeply rewarding. And that internal voice that asks, “Is this worth the investment?”—it isn’t wrong to ask. But compare it to the cost of temporary fixes: spa visits, self-care purchases, treatments that fade as soon as they’re over. This isn’t one more expense. It’s a one-time investment that upgrades the next decade of your life—and everyone who shares your home. Just imagine: a month from now, ending each evening with clarity instead of tension, warmth instead of stress. Waking up feeling more rested, more focused, more grounded. A new normal—built right into the architecture of your home. Features Premium Scandinavian Spruce Construction — Light, clean, and warmly aromatic, this wood elevates your home with a spa-quality aesthetic while naturally resisting heat and moisture. Freestanding FERO Electric Sauna Heater — Provides an authentic Finnish sauna experience with smooth, consistent heat—an anchor for your daily restoration ritual. Warm White 2700K Indirect Lighting — Creates a soft, calming glow that instantly signals the body to unwind. Dual Thermostatic Control — Maintains predictable, safe, and repeatable sessions—peace of mind built directly into the system. External Digital Display — Effortlessly manage temperature, session duration, and lighting without disrupting your interior environment. Aerotherm™ Ventilation System — Ensures fresh air circulation and oxygen supply, enhancing comfort and preventing fatigue during longer sessions. 2.1” (5.4 cm) Mineral Wool Insulation — Increases heat retention dramatically, lowering energy usage and maintaining a consistent climate inside the cabin. Tempered Glass Door & Windows (0.3” / 0.8 cm) — Designed to retain heat while opening the cabin visually, giving you both privacy and spaciousness. Cool-Touch Beech Wood Door Handles — Functional, elegant, and comfortable even at peak temperature. Tongue-and-Groove Construction — Provides a refined, seamless appearance and contributes to structural stability. Multiple Cabin Sizes — Configured for 2, 3, or up to 5 people, ensuring the perfect fit for your home and lifestyle. What's Included?
